datasets.rowMeaning: One customer identifier and its region.
datasets.title: Example customers and regions

datasets.rowMeaning: One row per order date and customer region with matched, non-cancelled orders.
datasets.title: Daily revenue by date and region

datasets.rowMeaning: One order with its order date, amount, and recorded status.

customers.dataGranularityDescription: One customer identifier and its region.
customers.description: Independently authored customer identifiers and region labels used to group the example orders. Region labels do not identify a documented geographic boundary.
customers.name: customers

properties.description: Customer identifier used to match orders to customer records.
properties.name: customer_id

properties.description: Region label assigned to the customer in the authored example. Geographic boundaries are not specified.
properties.name: region

daily-revenue.businessName: Daily revenue by date and region
daily-revenue.dataGranularityDescription: One row per order date and customer region with matched, non-cancelled orders.
daily-revenue.description: Totals from the authored commerce example, grouped by order date and customer region. The calculation excludes cancelled orders and orders without a matching customer. Amounts use integer minor currency units; the currency, scale, tax treatment and gross or net basis are not specified.
daily-revenue.name: daily_revenue

properties.description: Order date used to group the included example orders. No time of day or timezone is supplied.
properties.name: order_day

properties.description: Region label assigned to the customer in the authored example. Geographic boundaries are not specified.
properties.name: region

properties.description: Sum of the included order amounts for this date and customer region, in integer minor currency units. Currency, scale, tax treatment and gross or net basis are not specified.
properties.name: amount_cents

quality.description: Each order date and customer region occurs at most once.
quality.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_day, region FROM daily_revenue GROUP BY order_day, region HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS duplicate_groups

orders.dataGranularityDescription: One order with its order date, amount, and recorded status.
orders.description: Independently authored example orders with order dates, integer amounts, customer identifiers and recorded status. Includes a cancelled order and an order without a matching customer.
orders.name: orders

properties.description: Identifier for one order in the authored example.
properties.name: order_id

properties.description: Customer identifier used to match orders to customer records.
properties.name: customer_id

properties.description: Calendar date recorded for the order. No time of day or timezone is supplied.
properties.name: order_day

properties.description: An amount in integer minor currency units. The example does not specify the currency, scale, tax treatment or gross or net basis.
properties.name: amount_cents

properties.description: Recorded order status. The revenue calculation excludes the exact value 'cancelled'; the example also contains 'completed'. These examples do not define every allowed status.
properties.name: status
